text:
All Degen lanes are now holding new Swift jobs for batch 14. It starts as soon as the UI-test run and the lag lane’s last test end.

The share-upload lane named three missing guards. The Degen one, CI fast checks before a hand-off, goes into the repo’s debt notes. I’ll pass them to you word for word once the lane sends them.


Claude Code notice
Two guards for claude-settings came out of yesterday’s incidents. I can’t file them myself, because only claude-settings’ own triage writes its records.

Archive push check. It refuses a command that deletes a branch on GitHub unless the archive push before it succeeded. The incident, on 2026-11-07: the shell misread a branch name, so the archive pushes failed, and piping the output to tail hid the failure. Six branches were deleted with no archive copy. They were restored from the local clone, so nothing was lost.
Plain-writing lint before a record push. It refuses to push changed .md records while make lint-ste (the plain-writing check) fails on them. The incident, the same day: a 32-word sentence reached batch 14, and the batch runner had to split it.
To file them, paste this into your claude-settings session:

File two guard steps from Degen incidents of 2026-11-07. (1) archive-push-gates-delete: refuse a command that runs `git push --delete <branch>` after its archive push unless that push's own exit status gates the delete (no `| tail` or `;` between them). Incident: zsh read `$b:r` as a filename modifier, archive pushes failed, `tail` hid it, six branches were deleted with no archive copy, restored from the local clone. (2) lint-ste-before-record-push: refuse `git push` of a commit that changes `*.md` records while `make lint-ste` fails on them. Incident: a 32-word sentence in debt archiver-start-no-join reached Degen batch 14.
